title: No Scale Left Behind: Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Bi-directional Attention for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.38004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) plays a crucial role in healthcare, finance, industrial monitoring, and other sectors. Within and between these settings, anomalies span vastly different temporal scales, from sub-second point spikes to multi-hour drift patterns. However, most existing TSAD methods commit to a single temporal granularity, and multi-scale designs either analyze different scales in isolation or are constrained to a predefined coarse-to-fine hierarchy, both failing to sufficiently capture multi-scale interactions. To resolve this limitation, we propose Multi-Scale Autoencoder with Cross-Scale Attention for TSAD (MSCAD), a simple yet powerful semi-supervised TSAD framework founded on parallel autoencoder branches corresponding to different patch sizes. translated_title: 无一尺度被遗漏：面向时间序列异常检测的双向注意力多尺度自编码器
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）在医疗保健、金融、工业监测等领域发挥着至关重要的作用。在这些场景内部及之间，异常跨越了截然不同的时间尺度，从亚秒级的点状尖峰到持续数小时的漂移模式。然而，现有的大多数TSAD方法仅采用单一的时间粒度，而多尺度设计要么孤立地分析不同尺度，要么受限于预定义的由粗到细的层次结构，两者都无法充分捕获多尺度之间的交互。为解决这一局限，我们提出了面向时间序列异常检测的跨尺度注意力多尺度自编码器（MSCAD），这是一个简单而强大的半监督TSAD框架，其基础是对应于不同补丁大小的并行自编码器分支。一组对称的双向跨尺度注意力模块使任意两个尺度在重构之前都能交换信息，同时不允许任何单一尺度……
tldr: 提出MSCAD半监督异常检测框架，通过对应不同补丁大小的并行自编码器分支和对称双向跨尺度注意力模块，实现不同时间尺度间的充分信息交互，有效捕获从亚秒级尖峰到数小时漂移的多种异常模式。
en_tdlr: MSCAD, a simple yet powerful semi-supervised TSAD framework built on parallel autoencoder branches with symmetric bidirectional cross-scale attention blocks, enables sufficient information exchange across all pairs of temporal scales to capture anomalies ranging from sub-second point spikes to multi-hour drift patterns.
